info.title: musik API
info.description: Music player API. Legacy single-user password/token auth or invite-gated multi-user OIDC with revocable browser sessions and user-owned device bearer tokens. In multi-user mode device tokens are fixed to one owned profile and cannot manage accounts, tokens or shared-library jobs. Browser state changes require X-CSRF-Token. The Python worker owns Alembic migrations for SQLite or PostgreSQL; the Go player validates the migration head. Radio events remain idempotent and profile-scoped.

csrfToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
csrfToken.description: Required together with the session cookie for multi-user state changes.

event_id.description: Optional for legacy mobile events; newer clients use a stable id for retries. The server generates an id when omitted.

impression_id.description: Required for new radio clients. Omission invokes the legacy unambiguous fallback.

profile_id.description: Optional; omitted or empty selects the user's default profile.

token.description: Opaque secret shown only on creation or replacement.
